dialogues.speaker: Hung Fan
dialogues.text: Two boxes of tea leaves, and a bunch of crates of jade items and other miscellaneous goods? Business is booming lately, heh...

dialogues.speaker: Hung Fan
dialogues.text: You gotta be joking! I'm just a lowly laborer shifting goods who moonlights as a guard now and then.

dialogues.speaker: Hung Fan
dialogues.text: Business and all that's way too complicated for me, ha! I'd rather work my body than work my brain.

dialogues.speaker: Hung Fan
dialogues.text: See you, come talk to me again after I finish moving the tea leaves!

dialogues.speaker: Hung Fan
dialogues.text: *cough* Well, since I'm new to the biz, and I taught myself martial arts, I don't get a whole lotta commissions. Not like those pros from the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency...

dialogues.speaker: Hung Fan
dialogues.text: So, I'm just doin' simple transport work for now, gonna save up some cash for maybe a few years.

dialogues.speaker: Hung Fan
dialogues.text: Once I've got enough Mora in the bank, I'm gonna sign up for classes and study martial arts seriously, get myself real fists of fury and killer kung-fu kicks.

dialogues.speaker: Hung Fan
dialogues.text: And then I'll go pro, and escort with the best! I won't even have to fear getting eaten by Xuanwen Beasts...

dialogues.speaker: Hung Fan
dialogues.text: #I've seem 'em with my own eyes! You may be a tough young {M#hero}{F#heroine}, but don't get cocky!

dialogues.speaker: Hung Fan
dialogues.text: The things are practically invulnerable! I've seen my betters using real-deal Iron Points against one...

dialogues.speaker: Hung Fan
dialogues.text: They were ruthlessly trying to stick it, but it looked like it was enjoying being tickled.

dialogues.speaker: Hung Fan
dialogues.text: If it were me, I wouldn't last half a second before I ended up as a Xuanwen snack!

dialogues.speaker: Hung Fan
dialogues.text: If you run into one of those terrible monsters, I'd recommend just taking a detour!
